narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>One hundred and sixty eight has a seven that twelve does not have, so it is not divisible.
<bookmark mark='seven'/>But extra primes are fine, because they can go into a second group.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>What matters is that the primes of twelve are all there.
